NONE: C1 suitable or safe for eating
（無毒而）可以吃的；適宜食用的

example: Only the leaves of the plant are edible.
這種植物僅葉子可食。
Compare
eatable Opposite

NONE: › an official order, especially one that is given in a forceful and unfair way
法令，命令

example: The City Council issued an edict against spitting in the street.
市議會頒佈法令禁止隨地吐痰。
a religious edict
宗教法令

NONE: › the improvement of the mind and understanding, especially by learning
（尤指透過學習獲得的）教益，啓迪，陶冶

example: I tend to watch the television for pleasure rather than edification.
一般說來我看電視是為了消遣而不是為了要從中得到甚麼教誨。

NONE: › a large building, especially an impressive one
（尤指雄偉豪華的）大廈，宏偉建築
› a system that has been established for a long time
精神大廈（比喻存在已久的體系等）

example: The town hall is the only edifice surviving from the 15th century.
市政廳是唯一一座存留下來的15世紀的雄偉建築。
It looks as if the whole political edifice of the country is about to collapse.
看來整個國家的政治局勢是風雨飄搖、大廈將傾。

NONE: › to improve someone's mind
教化，啟迪，教誨
› improving your mind
啓迪的；起教化作用的

example: Being left in a bar all afternoon with a load of football fans is not the most edifying of experiences.
被留在酒吧裡和一幫足球迷整整待一下午，可不是甚麼有益身心的經歷。

NONE: B2 to make changes to a text or film, deciding what will be removed and what will be kept in, in order to prepare it for being printed or shown
編輯；校訂；剪輯
› to be in charge of the reports in a newspaper or magazine, etc.
任（報刊等）的主編

example: Janet edited books for a variety of publishers.
珍妮特爲許多出版社編輯過圖書。
The movie's 129 minutes were edited down from 150 hours of footage.
這部129分鐘的影片是從總長150小時的底片中剪輯出來的。
He edits a national newspaper.
他是一家全國性報紙的主編。

NONE: › to remove something before it is broadcast or printed
（從書或節目中）刪節，刪掉；將…剪掉

example: Most of the violent scenes were edited out for television.
為了適合電視播出，其中的大多數暴力場面都被剪掉了。

NONE: › an editable text, document, etc. can be changed
可編輯的，可修改的

example: The program lets you turn PDF files into editable text.
該系統能夠讓你把PDF格式的文件轉換成可編輯文本。
The game is editable by players.
這個遊戲的內容是可以由參與者修改的。

NONE: B2 a particular form in which a book, magazine, or newspaper is published
版本
› a single broadcast of a series of radio or television programmes
（廣播電視節目的）一期，一輯
› the total number of copies of a particular book, newspaper, etc. that are published at the same time
一版印刷總數；版次
› US one of a series of repeated events
（一系列重複進行的事件中的）一次，一回，一屆

example: the paperback/hardback edition of the dictionary
該詞典的平裝／精裝本
The regional editions of the paper contain specific information for that area.
該報地方版刊登一些針對當地讀者的內容。
This morning's edition of 'Women's Hour' is at the earlier time of a quarter to ten.
今天上午的《婦女時光》節目將提前到九點四十五分播出
She collects first editions of 19th-century authors.
她收藏19世紀作家著作的初版本。
The 77th edition of the Indianapolis 500 was held before an estimated 450,000 fans.
第77屆印弟安納波里斯500英里汽車賽吸引了大約45萬車迷觀看。

NONE: B2 a person who corrects or changes pieces of text or films before they are printed or shown, or a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine
（書的）編輯；（電影電視的）剪輯員；（報刊的）主編

example: She's a senior editor in the reference department of a publishing company.
她是出版社工具書室的資深編輯。
Who is the current editor of the Times?
《泰晤士報》的現任主編是誰？

NONE: › an article in a newspaper that expresses the editor's opinion on a subject of particular interest at the present time
社論，社評
› relating to editors or editing, or to the editor of a newspaper or magazine
編輯的；主編的；編者的

example: All the papers deal with the same subject in their editorials.
所有的報紙都針對同一問題發表了社論。
Editorial decisions are generally made by senior editors.
通常由資深編輯們來決定編務事宜。
It's plain reporting of the facts - there's not much editorial content (= opinion).
那只是純粹的事實報道，沒有多少評論內容。

NONE: › to express a personal opinion, especially when you should be giving a report of the facts only
（尤指在本應客觀報道事實時擅自）發表個人觀點，進行主觀評論
